title: First Human Powered Ornithopter
content: Engineers have succeeded in a short sustained flight by an ultra-lightweight human-powered ornithopter. Instead of using a propellor, the machine propels itself by powered undulations of the wing.Previously on GJ:Insect VehiclesButterfly Flight MechanicsOrnithopter ZoneYouTube video of machine-powered "UTIAS" ornithopter
